about: The Lumbridge Swamp Caves' own monsters and fishing spots (Misthalin piece 7 steps 3a and 3b): cave bugs (level 6), cave bug larvae, cave slimes (23), cave crawlers (23), big frogs (24), giant frogs (99), cave goblins (3) and the two frog spawn and eel fishing spots. Each tile and type is mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live), kept to the caves' dark tiles (areas/lumbridge-swamp-caves-dark.txt); the counts agree with the OSRS Wiki's Lumbridge Swamp Caves page (21 bugs, 36 larvae, 17 slimes, 11 big frogs, 3 crawlers, 3 giant frogs, 4 cave goblins; read 2026-11-10). Step 3b adds the 5 rockslugs and the 7 wall beasts' holes (the holes on their wall tiles, never moving). The H.A.M. Hideout's people are step 4's. Every wander range is guessed (5), as elsewhere. Combat and drops are npc-combat.json's and npc-drops.json's.
